title: Gift from a fiancé vs a fiancée (menu)
source: Loan officers ask what to collect for a gift.
paraphrases: fannie conventional purchase, 1 unit primary. my borrower is getting a 15k gift from {cue}, wired straight to title. the donor is not on the loan or title. on conventional, does the gift giver have to provide their bank statement? what do i need for the gift?
gift question on a fannie primary purchase: 15k from {cue}, going directly to title, donor not on loan or title. what documents do i need for the gift?
my client has a $15,000 gift coming from {cue}, wire to title, conv fannie 1 unit primary. donor isn't on the loan or title. what's needed to document the gift?
turns: ok can you write me the needs list email to {obj}, short and friendly

for my file, from this menu pick every item I need to collect, ask about, or look into before I submit. Reply with one JSON object only: {{"attention_item_ids": [...]}}

{menu}

menu.M1: signed gift letter (amount, relationship, no repayment)
menu.M2: wire confirmation from the donor's account
menu.M3: settlement statement showing the gift received
menu.M4: donor's bank statement showing the funds
menu.M7: proof the donor lives with the borrower
menu.M11: note: the donor is an interested party, so the gift cannot be used

gold: B and C: M1-M4 only (Fannie B3-4.3-04: an individual engaged to marry the borrower is an acceptable donor; no proof of the relationship); D must pick M11
